summary: Backend-only regression for the new DEFAULT_CLUB_CONFIG (theme_preset='futbase_oro', dark_mode=True). Added /app/backend/tests/test_theme_defaults.py with 10 tests covering: fresh coach register-coach -> token+user ENTRENADOR, GET /auth/me 200, GET /config returns theme_preset='futbase_oro' AND dark_mode=True AND custom_colors=null for a brand-new club, GET /club/invite returns a valid invite_code, register-parent with valid code (PADRE + /auth/me 200 + login + PUT /config = 403), register-parent with invalid code = 404, PUT /config theme payload persists via GET for coach, dark_mode toggles both ways, and login regression for coach@test.com/test123. Full suite: 53/53 PASSED (43 previous + 10 new).

minor.issue: Default theme_preset='futbase_oro' and dark_mode=True are correctly applied for freshly-registered clubs (via DEFAULT_CLUB_CONFIG spread at register-coach time and get_club setdefault fallback).

action_items: Nothing blocking. Carryover (optional, from iter_2): return 404 on cross-club PUT /{teams,matches,players}/{id} instead of 200+null; rate-limit /auth/forgot-password BEFORE insert; magic-byte sniff on /api/upload; split server.py (764 lines) into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: DEFAULT_CLUB_CONFIG at /app/backend/server.py:101-110 correctly sets theme_preset='futbase_oro' and dark_mode=True; register-coach spreads it into the new club document (line 304-307) so GET /config returns the new defaults immediately.
PUT /api/config correctly whitelists {theme_preset, custom_colors, dark_mode, ...} and uses require_coach dependency, so PADRE receives 403 (verified).
register-parent returns 404 on bad invite_code (line 325) — verified.
coach@test.com/test123 still logs in (no password/token_version regression after DEFAULT_CLUB_CONFIG change).
seed_data_creation: Transient coach_theme_* (ENTRENADOR), parent_theme_* / parent_bad_* (PADRE) accounts and their clubs are created per test session. No modifications to the fixed coach@test.com account. All test data is prefixed and isolated per club.
